questions.title: The screen's job is clear from the first screen
questions.why: 'Successfully listed!' with the listing card and confetti is unmistakable.

questions.title: The action that does the job stands out most
questions.why: Two filled teal buttons, 'Manage listings' and 'Choose Bumps', compete for the primary.

questions.title: Every label says what happens when tapped
questions.why: 'Manage listings' and 'Choose Bumps' say what they open.

questions.title: No terms this user wouldn't know
questions.why: 'Bump' is explained by its line, but 'Listing will be auto-renewed in 30 days' and 'Recommended' come with no reason.

questions.title: Only asks what this user can decide at this stage
questions.why: It asks the seller to buy Bumps ('From 150 or S$1.50') with a 0-Coin balance seconds after listing, before they've seen any views.

questions.title: Advanced detail is tucked away
questions.why: Bump detail is behind its info icon.

questions.title: Everything fits this stage and this user
questions.why: Promotion right after listing is this screen's intended moment.

questions.title: Little reading needed to act
questions.why: Labels and prices carry it; the Bump description is one line.
